summary: Say or sign the counting numbers in order, by ones, up to at least 20.
See how many are in a small group, up to 5, without counting, and say the number.
Count up to 10 things one by one, know the last number is how many, and that each next number is one more.
Say if a group has more, fewer or the same as another (up to 5), and use first to tenth for order.
Match groups of 0 to 5 to their written numbers, and with help write some numbers up to 10.
Add and take away up to 5 with fingers, objects or drawings, and begin counting on and counting back.
Fill in a missing piece of a pattern, copy and extend patterns, and find the part that repeats.
Measure with same-size units like snap cubes, and compare or order up to five things by height or weight.
Name shapes of any size or turn, count their sides and corners, sort flat and solid shapes, and build shapes.
Use words like up, down, in front and behind, and follow directions to stand up or move forward.
